Reset()

Reset this handler to a sane default state. This should reset any settings a consumer or user may have changed in order to attempt to make the handler usable again.

public virtual void Reset()

Remarks

An example would be a user setting the sensitivity too high to turn it back down, or restricting the navigable screen area too small. Calling this would attempt to return the user to a sane state so they could re-attempt configuration changes.
